_doc: Artifact items: 30 Trinkets, 20 Wonders, 6 cursed Wonders, 12 Marvel pieces, 4 assembled Marvels, 12 consumables. 32x32 symbols on a transparent background, docs/art/classes/icons.md. One generate-image-v2 call at 32x32 returns 64 candidates of a mixed subject ("each image a different one of these"); the best take per subject is accepted. Frames (school, grade) are drawn by code, never baked. Never downscaled or mirrored. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.
